covered.rule: 1 First sentence: automated assistant of Bank 20, call recorded; ask with title and last name
2 never say collections, debt, payment, credit card or loan before verification
3 ask once more; still unclear -> no-contact/unclear
4 robot reply / scam reply and continue
5 third party: say nothing, ask when reachable
6 callback today or next business day 09:00-17:30, after now -> no-contact/cb-set
7 outside window ask once more -> no-contact/cb-none
18 collections intro; up to 3 products; state all; ask once pay all today
19 floors and names per product type
20 full first, never ask how much, floor once 'the rest stays overdue'
22 band table 1-60, third business day, 2 attempts
23 attempt 1 full last business day this/next week (floor if full refused); attempt 2 floor on deadline
27 hardship: sympathy, welfare offer, decline -> no-ptp/vulnerable, record promise
29 human after verification, no ask -> front-desk
30 read-back 'Do you confirm?', one promise per product
34 same call, common date clamped, one read-back, transfer keeps promise
